verdict.rationale: Ultrametric ships a CLI and hosted service, so a telemetry opt-out is a fair question to ask of it, but the evidence pack never mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any switch to disable them. The local per-command diagnostics from `logs show`, the settings paths shown by `doctor`, and the note that adapter context 'stays local during retrieval' are related features, not an opt-out control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
